name: Jörgen Warborn - Article 2 – alinéa 1 – point 12 – sous-point a; Article 40 bis – paragraphe 1 – alinéa 2 - Am 63
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: Amendment (1c) in Article 3(1), point (f) is replaced by the following: ‘(f) ‘business partner’ means an entity with which the company has a commercial agreement related to the operations, products or services of the company or to which the company provides services pursuant to point (g);’ (i) with which the company has a commercial agreement related to the operations, products or services of the company or to which the company provides services pursuant to point (g) (‘direct business partner’); or (ii) which is not a direct business partner but which performs business operations related to the operations, products or services of the company (‘indirect business partner’);
